set.body:
WHY: the WL feature compiler (WLTrace, WLSubtreeFeatures, WLOAThresholdFeatures, FeatureMatrix) lives in engine-jvm and depends on gale (JVM+JS only) and java.util.concurrent; cross-platform consumers get kernels and interners but no feature vectors. grakern's README claims core/standard are portable; the emitter should be.

SCOPE (in standard, pure): FeatureEmitter producing, per sample, a SparseFeatureRow (sorted coordinate ids + Double values) and a FeatureDictionary[Coordinate] that is serializable given named codecs (coordinates keyed by SemanticFingerprint + round + colour serialization, not by trace-scoped object identity). engine-jvm keeps the Gale CSR/Gram/operator lowering and is re-expressed as a consumer of the portable rows. No parallelism in standard; the JVM engine may parallelize.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. standardJVM/JS/Native all compile and run the emitter tests; no java.util.concurrent, no gale in standard.
2. For every fixture, engine-jvm's FeatureMatrix built from portable rows equals the previous FeatureMatrix bit-for-bit (values and coordinate dictionary order).
3. FeatureDictionary round-trips through a codec (JSON in test scope) and a row emitted in a fresh process aligns to it (same coordinate ids) when the same named codecs are supplied; without named codecs the dictionary is Ephemeral and refuses serialization with a typed error.
4. Cosine over two portable rows == normalized kernel value from the JVM engine (within 1e-12).

PROPOSED TESTS
- EmitterParitySuite (JVM): rows -> CSR == golden FeatureMatrix.
- EmitterPortabilitySuite (JS + Native): same fixtures, same rows, compare checksums of serialized rows against JVM-produced goldens committed to the repo.
- DictionaryRoundTripSuite: serialize/deserialize; alignment of a new sample's row; Ephemeral refusal.
- CosineEqualsKernelSuite: property over generated graphs.
